financial_history.comparability_note: FY2021—FY2023 是当年集团口径；2025 将美业解决方案列为终止经营，只有 FY2024 比较数被重列。跨年总收入与利润必须标记范围断点，不能把 FY2021—FY2024 reported total 与 FY2025 continuing revenue 直接视为同口径。

incremental_roic.reason: FY2024 to FY2025 average operating capital declined as contract liabilities grew; mechanical delta NOPAT / delta capital has a negative denominator and is not economically interpretable.

returns_on_capital_screen.method: Core operating profit excludes other income, finance, associates and selected non-operating items; NOPAT applies a 25% screening tax rate when positive; average operating capital includes operating assets less operating liabilities and contract liabilities.
limitations: 研发费用没有资本化，会抬高成熟期 ROIC。
2024—2025 分子为持续经营而资产负债表分母仍是集团口径。
订阅合同负债显著降低经营资本；这是有价值的 float，也可能在增长放缓时回转。
这是研究筛查指标，不是公司披露或稳定经济 ROIC。
